title: Precision Teaching Study - Coaching condition
text:
Welcome to the Precision Teaching study website. This page includes the required activities for participants assigned to this study condition.
In this condition, you will complete weekly instructional videos, attend weekly live coaching sessions, complete frequency-building practice, and complete weekly quizzes.









Week
Required Activities




Week 1
Complete the pretest, Week 1 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 1 quiz


Week 2
Complete the Week 2 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 2 quiz


Week 3
Complete the Week 3 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 3 quiz


Week 4
Complete the Week 4 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 4 quiz


Week 5
Complete the Week 5 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, posttest, and Week 5 quiz
